body: did you know: the girl in "august" almost had a name. she is folklore's third love-triangle narrator -- the summer that "slipped away" -- and is never named in the lyrics. in the long pond sessions taylor mused she might be "augusta. or augustine." fans made it canon.
why: X-native (text-only) version of the folklore 'august' did-you-know, keeping X active and riding the same 'salt-air month' fan ritual (today's listening scan). Trimmed to the sharpest facts: the unnamed third narrator of the love triangle and Taylor's 'Augusta or Augustine' musing from the Long Pond Sessions. Every claim traces to the Vault folklore 'august... Augusta. Or Augustine.' item (Wikipedia). 'salt air' is a real lyric. Song-craft lore only, outside every blocklist topic.
